# TransitRail

> TransitRail is a free, no-registration rail and public-transit route finder for 11 countries and territories in Asia, Europe, and North America. The app is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean; static route pages are also published in French and German.

## Canonical pages

- Homepage: https://rail-national.vercel.app/
- Route timetable directory: https://rail-national.vercel.app/routes/
- Traditional Chinese route timetable directory: https://rail-national.vercel.app/zh/routes/
- Country hubs (static timetable indexes with geo metadata): e.g. https://rail-national.vercel.app/japan/ , /hong-kong/ , /united-kingdom/ , …
- Multilingual country hubs: /zh/{country}/ , /ja/{country}/ , /ko/{country}/ , /fr/{country}/ , /de/{country}/
- XML sitemap (flat urlset): https://rail-national.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## What TransitRail provides

- Searchable rail and metro information for Japan, Korea, Malaysia, Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, the United States, Germany, France, Belgium, Norway, and Switzerland.
- Static route pages with departure times, arrival times, transfers, fares when available, source attribution, and timetable snapshot dates.
- Live provider responses for selected routes where a provider integration is available; otherwise, official operator timetable snapshots.

## Data-use guidance

- Treat static route pages as planning references, not a guarantee of service.
- The route page footer identifies the data source and, when available, the timetable snapshot date.
- Search results identify whether data came from a provider response or a pre-scraped official timetable snapshot.
- Always confirm timings, fares, disruptions, accessibility, and booking conditions with the transport operator before travelling.

## Citation guidance

- Cite the exact canonical route URL for route-specific departure, duration, transfer, fare, and source information.
- Cite the homepage for product coverage and service capability.
